strings.zh: 我昨天去精灵之塔扫墓{NEWLINE}居然在里面遇到了一只巨大的绿毛虫！{SCROLL}我最害怕虫子了,{NEWLINE}吓得我一溜烟就跑出来了。{CLEAR}真是太可怕了。
strings.en: Yesterday I went to Pokémon Tower to{NEWLINE}visit a grave, and I ran into a giant{CLEAR}Caterpie in there!{SCROLL}I’m terrified of bugs, so I ran straight{NEWLINE}out of there. It was so scary.

strings.zh: 紫苑镇上有两处{NEWLINE}安放精灵遗体的建筑,{CLEAR}你知道它们的来历吗？
strings.en: Lavender Town has two buildings where{NEWLINE}the remains of Pokémon are laid to rest.{CLEAR}Do you know their history?

strings.zh: 我把曾经的精灵伙伴{NEWLINE}安放在这座灵魂之家里。{CLEAR}每年我都会来这里给它扫墓。
strings.en: I laid my old Pokémon partner to rest{NEWLINE}here in the House of Memories. I come to{CLEAR}visit its grave every year.

strings.zh: 据说最近精灵之塔上{NEWLINE}时常会发生灵异事件呢。{CLEAR}大家都不敢上塔扫墓了。{SCROLL}该不会是前段时间{NEWLINE}被火箭队残害的精灵变成了恶鬼吧！
strings.en: They say strange, ghostly things have{NEWLINE}been happening in Pokémon Tower lately.{CLEAR}Nobody dares visit the graves anymore.{SCROLL}You don’t think the Pokémon Team{NEWLINE}Rocket cruelly killed a while back have{CLEAR}turned into vengeful spirits, do you?
strings.notes: tone review: 残害 = cruelly harm; these Pokémon died and became 恶鬼, so 'cruelly killed' (D-0627)

strings.zh: 这里是紫苑镇,{NEWLINE}是口袋妖怪们的灵魂归宿之地。
strings.en: This is Lavender Town, where{NEWLINE}Pokémon spirits come to rest.

strings.zh: 这里是爱心人士聚集的{NEWLINE}精灵之家
这里是灵魂之家{NEWLINE}精灵们在这里沉睡
strings.en: House of Memories{NEWLINE}May Pokémon Spirits Rest Easy

strings.zh: 南边的圆顶建筑叫做灵魂之家,{NEWLINE}最初紫苑镇的人们{CLEAR}就是在灵魂之家安放精灵遗体的。{SCROLL}后来许多外地人{NEWLINE}也将他们精灵的遗体、骨灰{CLEAR}安放到灵魂之家。{CLEAR}结果灵魂之家的墓地就不够用了。{SCROLL}于是镇上就建起了{NEWLINE}北面这座高耸的精灵之塔{CLEAR}用来安放更多的精灵遗体。
strings.en: The domed building to the south is{NEWLINE}called the House of Memories. At first,{CLEAR}the people of Lavender Town laid their{CLEAR}Pokémon to rest there.{SCROLL}Later, many people from out of town{NEWLINE}also brought the remains and ashes of{CLEAR}their Pokémon to the House of Memories.{SCROLL}Eventually the graveyard there ran out{NEWLINE}of room.{SCROLL}So the town built the tall Pokémon{NEWLINE}Tower to the north to lay more Pokémon{CLEAR}to rest.

strings.zh: 希望每一只去世口袋妖怪的灵魂{NEWLINE}都可以得到安息。
strings.en: I hope the spirit of every Pokémon that{NEWLINE}has passed away can rest in peace.

strings.zh: 听说精灵之塔已经{NEWLINE}不会在发生让人害怕的灵异事件了。
strings.en: I heard the scary ghostly happenings in{NEWLINE}Pokémon Tower have stopped.

strings.zh: 听菊子大人说,{NEWLINE}原来精灵之塔上的怪谈{CLEAR}都是火箭队搞的鬼。{CLEAR}知道真相后总算是能安心了。
strings.en: Agatha told me the Pokémon Tower ghost{NEWLINE}stories were all Team Rocket’s doing.{SCROLL}What a relief to finally know the truth.

strings.zh: 不久前火箭队曾经来过这里,{NEWLINE}我亲眼看到他们杀害了{CLEAR}很多不愿意被他们收服的精灵……
strings.en: Not long ago Team Rocket came here. I{NEWLINE}saw them with my own eyes, killing lots{CLEAR}of Pokémon that wouldn’t let themselves{CLEAR}be caught...

strings.zh: 被无辜杀害的精灵{NEWLINE}实在是太可怜了。{SCROLL}希望他们{NEWLINE}能在这座灵魂归宿之镇安息吧！
strings.en: Those innocent Pokémon who were{NEWLINE}killed... It’s just too sad.{SCROLL}I hope they can rest in peace in this{NEWLINE}town of resting spirits!
I want to see you. I want to see you so{NEWLINE}much!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}被一股神奇的力量拉了过去！
要使用10张清净符护身吗？
你根本没有那么多清净符！
strings.en: You don’t have that many Cleanse Tags!
